Minecraft Hosting

Choose your hardware tier and RAM

HDXCLOUD offers three Minecraft hosting tiers, each priced per GB of RAM per month and each with SSD storage included. Use the RAM selector on each plan to preview the monthly total instantly.

Three hardware tiers

Intel Xeon E5-2620 v4, Intel Xeon 6, and AMD EPYC 9755 / Intel Core Ultra 9 (node-dependent).

SSD storage included

All Minecraft plans include SSD storage; capacity depends on the selected plan and RAM.

Transparent per-GB pricing

₹10, ₹20, or ₹30 per GB of RAM per month depending on the selected plan.

About online RAM limits

Online selections support from 1 GB to 32 GB of RAM. If you need more than 32 GB, contact HDXCLOUD support through a Discord ticket once the official invite is published to discuss custom requirements.

Orders are placed through the HDXCLOUD client billing panel. For policies and terms, see docs.hdxclouds.info.
